title: jasione tomentosa
intro: Jasione tomentosa, commonly known as the woolly bellflower, is a flowering plant species within the bellflower family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Jasione tomentosa include its use in traditional medicine for wound healing, as well as its potential to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
